# Zen Hobi Sanat

> Ceramics, painting, sculpture, pouring art, decorative painting, candle making and kids' art studio in Bahçeşehir, Başakşehir, Istanbul, Turkey. Operating since 2014. Offers both individual hobby courses for adults and children, and corporate art events / team building activities for companies.

Zen Hobi Sanat is a local art hobby studio located at Bahçeşehir 2. Kısım Mah. M. Kemal Atatürk Bulvarı No:23 D:1, Başakşehir, İstanbul, Turkey. Phone: +90 544 403 42 66. Email: info@zenhobisanat.com. Registration inquiries: kayit@zenhobisanat.com.

## Courses & Studios
- [Ceramics Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/seramik.html): Hand-building, glazing and kiln firing. The studio's most popular course.
- [Painting Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/resim.html): Acrylic, oil painting and charcoal drawing.
- [Pouring Art](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/pouring-art.html): Brushless fluid acrylic painting technique.
- [Sculpture Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/heykel.html): Clay and plaster sculpture, bust and figure modeling.
- [Decorative Painting](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/ahsap-dekoratif-boyama.html): Decorative painting, distressing and pattern techniques on wood, ceramic and glass.
- [Candle Making Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/mum-yapimi-atolyesi.html): Natural soy candle pouring, completed in a single session.
- [Kintsugi Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/kintsugi-atolyesi.html): The Japanese art of repairing broken ceramics with a gold-pigmented paste, completed in a single session.
- [Punch Needle Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/punch-atolyesi.html): Stitching colorful yarn patterns into stretched fabric with a punch needle, completed in a single session.
- [Mosaic Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/mozaik-atolyesi.html): Creating patterns and images with glass and ceramic mosaic pieces, completed in a single session.
- [Watercolor Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/suluboya-atolyesi.html): Painting on paper with watercolor, choosing your own composition.
- [Textured Painting Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/dokulu-tablo-atolyesi.html): Building raised, textured compositions on canvas with a palette knife and acrylic plaster.
- [Creative Kids Studio](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/cocuk-atolyesi.html): Art classes for children ages 4+, planned and guided by a clinical child neuropsychologist.
- [Workshops](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/workshoplar.html): One-session art experiences for groups, couples and individuals — no ongoing commitment required.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/kurumsal-etkinlikler.html): Team building and corporate art activities for companies.
- [Kiln Firing Service](https://www.zenhobisanat.com/firinlama.html): Kiln firing service for ceramic pieces made elsewhere.
